correctness.rationale: The period-3 to scalar quadratic reduction is bijective. Complete degree-six dynatomic root count follows from an exact discriminant and two real cubics with positive discriminants. Direct symbolic matrix multiplication yields the return characteristic polynomial. Four necessary-and-sufficient real cubic Schur inequalities give the strict sink interval, and a monotone cubic supplies unique endpoints. Exact factorization proves the two distinct spectral boundary types; Taylor expansion and mean-value theorem prove the quadratic and cubic asymptotic coefficients. verify.py rechecks all critical algebra. Numerical probes are supplemental.

value.rationale: The exact nonempty local sink window is a natural global-in-parameter classification of all primitive three-cycles of a standard polynomial diffeomorphism; it identifies two distinct stability-loss mechanisms. Quadratic opening of an unstable birth gap at zero coupling and cubic closing of the entire sink interval near unit contraction are sharp, structurally motivated singular regimes, not arbitrary parameter slices.
